description: Approach the nearest confirmed person and stop at its default gap (gap_min(person) rounded up to 0.1 m, car front to the person's near edge, resolved at load), then drive straight 3 m, then drive into the door on the LEFT and stop in it, facing the way through. The straight starts facing the person, so it drives toward them: either clear the path or use it as the obstacle-avoidance test (the person stays, the MPC must go round; mpc_avoidance_mode decides how). The person must be in view at the start: acquire_timeout_sec 10. Door move as straight_3m_then_left_door_direct (scripts/sim/office_batch): no pre-point (approach_dist_m 0.05), the goal is the door centre with its yaw; the door is picked once, the nearest STRONG confirmed door on the left of the car's heading when the move starts; door_not_found after 5 s aborts. Entered means within 0.15 m along the axis, 0.05 m sideways and 10 deg. Needs semantic_layer_node (/costmap/semantic_tracks), a door detector (/perception/doors_semantic) and the global EKF.
